caption: The 33-byte public key is hashed to 20 bytes; adding the 1-byte version and 4-byte checksum gives the 25 bytes that Base58Check encodes. The address carries a hash of the key, never the key itself.

spec.title: From key to address
spec.aria: A 256-bit private key gives a 33-byte compressed public key, which hashes to 20 bytes; adding a 1-byte version and a 4-byte checksum makes 25 bytes, encoded in Base58Check as an address starting with 1.
